offers.name: Lenovo Legion 5 16" WQXGA 240Hz Gaming Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX - 16GB - 1TB SSD - RTX 5060 - Windows 11 Pro - Gray

reviews.quote: It's built well and clean looking, offers solid ergonomics, decent inputs ... the mid-range RTX 5060/5070 options are the ones to look at, as they are priced competitively and can be properly tamed in this chassis.

professional.note: No pro review found for the Legion 5 16 Gen 10 IPS config (NBC's Legion 5 16 Series page has only Gen 9 — verified live 2026-11-24; honest disclosure per SHARED-legion5-ips.md). Ratings inferred from the Pro 5 16 Gen 10 collection (86.8%) and Legion 5 15 chassis reviews (87%).

praises: 240Hz 16" WQXGA matte IPS — the smoothest panel in the Legion 5 range and flicker-free (no PWM)
Ultra 9 275HX (24-core Arrow Lake-HX) is a desktop-class CPU; UltrabookReview notes the 5060 'can be properly tamed in this chassis' — cool and quiet for the tier
Deep sale pricing: regular $4,649 → $3,249 makes the big-screen Legion genuinely mainstream-priced
Bigger chassis = better thermals than the 15" tiers at the same GPU TGP (NBC chassis testing)
Dual SODIMM (to 64GB), dual M.2, screwed battery — full Legion serviceability
complaints: 16GB RAM undercuts the otherwise workstation-grade CPU — the 32GB twin is worth comparing
RTX 5060 is the mismatch: a 24-core CPU with a mid GPU skews away from gaming at native 1600p
Heavier class: ~2.4 kg / ~25 mm — a step down in portability vs the 15" Legion 5s
No card reader; speakers 'could be better' (recurring Legion cons)
Legion platform threads report warranty friction and occasional fan-bearing grind; 50-series nvlddmkm TDR crashes appear on some units

standouts: 24-core CPU + 240Hz 16" panel at $3,249 sale — strong CPU-first gaming/desktop-replacement combo
design_philosophy: Lenovo's 16" Legion 5 Gen 10 brings the Pro 5 chassis size to the mainstream tier: bigger cooling, 240Hz matte panel, desktop-class HX CPUs, no lighting gimmicks. This entry tier pairs the top CPU with the entry GPU — a CPU-first build that shines in mixed work+gaming rather than pure FPS-per-dollar.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC Legion Pro 5 16 Gen 10 collection (86.8%) + Legion 5 15 chassis (87%) per SHARED-legion-pro5.md / SHARED-legion5-oled.md, IPS deltas per SHARED-legion5-ips.md: 240Hz WQXGA IPS -> screen_quality 6.4, readability_dark 6.8 (no PWM), readability_bright 7.0; RTX 5060 -> gaming 6.4, thermals +0.3 for bigger chassis; 275HX 24c -> productivity 8.8; 16GB -> productivity -0.5 / ai_ml -0.3; 16" -> screen_size 7.5 / portability 5.8.
